question: What is the first-response target for a High priority case on the Business plan?
expected_answer: 4 hours on Business (2 hours on Enterprise).

question: A user in a workspace that requires SSO says the password reset email never arrives. Why?
expected_answer: When SSO is enforced Lumora doesn't send reset emails, because the identity provider manages the password. The user should sign in with Continue with SSO and reset the password through their company IdP.
key_facts: identity provider; IdP; Continue with SSO

question: Someone got locked out for a whole day after only three wrong passwords. Is that a bug?
expected_answer: No. The workspace admin has set a strict sign-in policy (failed attempts can be set from 3 to 10, lockout from 15 minutes to 24 hours on Business/Enterprise). An Admin can unlock them right away under Settings > Members > ⋯ > Unlock account.

question: Every 6-digit code from my authenticator app is rejected, even when I type it fast.
expected_answer: The phone's clock is probably more than about 60 seconds off (TOTP, 30-second window). Turn on automatic date and time, delete old Lumora entries in the app, restart 2FA setup and scan the new QR code.

question: Our SAML login fails with 'Assertion expired'. What is the allowed clock skew?
expected_answer: 3 minutes. The IdP server's clock is off; fix NTP on the IdP.

question: After users log out of Okta, their open Lumora tabs keep working. Is this fixed yet?
expected_answer: It's an open known issue, ENG-4471, with a fix planned for release 2026.11.1. Workarounds: configure Single Logout in both the IdP and Lumora, shorten the session lifetime (to as little as 1 hour), turn on Disable offline cache on shared devices, and sign out in Lumora as well. Link the case to ENG-4471.

question: A user's role is Admin but every option they see is read-only. What should I check first?
expected_answer: Their seat type. A Viewer seat is read-only even with the Admin role; change the seat to Full in Settings > Members. Then check: wrong workspace, past-due billing (read-only except Owners), stale session, SCIM group mapping.

question: Invitations show 'Pending — awaiting seat' and nobody gets an email. Why?
expected_answer: Every paid seat is in use, so the invite waits and no email is sent. Add seats or free one up.

question: What's the difference between deactivating and removing a user?
expected_answer: Deactivate frees the seat, keeps what the user created assigned to them and can be reversed. Remove frees the seat, moves their open tasks to someone you choose and can't be reversed.

question: A customer updated their card and now sees a pending charge that isn't on any invoice. Do we refund it?
expected_answer: No. It's a card authorization hold, not a charge; it disappears within 3–7 business days. Nothing to refund.

question: Can I refund a $700 true duplicate charge without approval?
expected_answer: Yes. Agents can refund true duplicates without approval. The $500 Billing Lead approval rule applies only to other refunds. Refund the duplicate payment (not the invoice) with reason Duplicate.

question: Billing history shows two invoices with the same number, one ending -V and one ending -R1. Will we be charged twice?
expected_answer: No. The -V invoice is the voided original and -R1 is the revision; only the revision is charged. Hide voided invoices or use Export statement for accounting.

question: A customer's payment failed 20 days ago. What can their users do in the workspace now?
expected_answer: After the 14-day grace period the workspace is read-only for everyone except Owners, who can still reach billing. It will be suspended after day 60. An Owner restores access by updating the payment method and clicking Retry payment.

question: A bulk import took storage from 60% straight to 100% and no one got the 80% or 95% warning. Is that expected?
expected_answer: Yes, it's a known gap: if storage jumps from below 80% to 100% in one day, only the 100% message appears. A daily check to catch this is planned for 2026.11. At 100%, new uploads and new file versions are blocked.

question: On the Business plan, what's the biggest file I can upload in the browser, and is there a way to go bigger?
expected_answer: 250 MB on web and mobile. The API resumable upload (POST /v2/files/uploads, 8 MB chunks) allows up to 1 GB on Business. Other options: link from cloud storage or upgrade to Enterprise (2 GB web).

question: We're on Team and our integration sends only about 80 requests a minute, but we still get 429 errors. Why?
expected_answer: The 100/min limit is per workspace, shared by every API token and installed integration, so other apps (for example the Salesforce connector or BI tools) use the same allowance. Check Settings > API > Usage for per-token and per-integration usage.

question: Our webhook endpoint was disabled after an outage. How do we get the events we missed?
expected_answer: Fix the endpoint, click Re-enable and choose Replay failed events, which resends events from the last 72 hours.

question: Old links to the API docs with #section anchors now return 404. What's going on?
expected_answer: The v1 docs were retired on 2026-08-01 when the developer site moved, and deep links with anchors don't redirect (known issue DOC-311). Replace /docs/api/ with /v2/reference/ in the URL or search the developer site.

question: Exporting a 120,000-row table to CSV downloads an empty file.
expected_answer: Exports over 50,000 rows run in the background, and the immediate download returns an empty file. Use Export > CSV (email me when ready); the link is valid for 7 days (max 1,000,000 rows).

question: A customer got a scheduled export on 2026-09-10 that contained Sensitive fields. How should I handle it?
expected_answer: It matches ENG-4388 (scheduled exports only, releases 2026.08.1 to 2026.09.1, fixed in 2026.09.2 on 2026-09-16). Treat it as a possible data exposure: set priority to at least High, don't ask for the file, and escalate to Security & Privacy.

question: Can scheduled reports be delivered straight to an Amazon S3 bucket?
expected_answer: Yes, in beta since 2026.10.1, on Business and above. An Owner turns it on under Settings > Labs > Scheduled exports to cloud storage; S3 needs a bucket with an IAM role ARN. For feature-request cases, link FR-118 and close as Resolved – Available in beta.

question: A scheduled report set to New York time back in July runs at the wrong hour. How do we fix it?
expected_answer: Schedules created before 2026.08.2 saved the timezone as UTC. Edit the schedule, change any setting and change it back, then Save; that rewrites the stored timezone.

question: One dashboard widget still shows July revenue while the others are current.
expected_answer: Most likely the widget's date filter uses fixed dates. Edit the widget, go to Filters > Date and choose a relative range such as This month or Last 30 days. Also check paused snapshots, connector sync, the 15-minute cache, and the source report.

question: The browser freezes when I filter a table with 200,000 rows.
expected_answer: Turn on server-side filtering: View settings > Performance > Filter on server, which loads one 500-row page at a time. Also filter on indexed fields, use saved views and hide formula columns. From 2026.11 it turns on automatically above 50,000 rows.

question: The Salesforce connector disconnects like clockwork every 12 hours.
expected_answer: The connected app's refresh token policy is set to expire. In Salesforce Setup, under Connected Apps OAuth Usage > Lumora Workspace > Edit Policies, set Refresh Token Policy to 'Refresh token is valid until revoked'.
key_facts: Refresh Token Policy; valid until revoked

question: A payment form's transaction log has no entries at all. What does that mean?
expected_answer: The form never reaches the payment step. Check the payment field's conditional logic. Payment failures are always Urgent.

question: I click Delete on a custom field and nothing happens.
expected_answer: The field is still used somewhere (automations, reports, forms, formulas, integrations or required-field rules), and the message listing the references can close straight away (defect ENG-4502, fix due 2026.11.1). Open the field's Usage tab, remove each reference and delete again, or archive the field instead.

question: A scheduled automation rule updates 200 tasks. How many runs does that use?
expected_answer: 200 runs, one per task.

question: My daily recurring task keeps showing up on Saturdays and Sundays.
expected_answer: That's expected: Daily includes weekends. Change Repeat to Every weekday (Mon–Fri), or set custom working days and use Every working day.

question: A user on iOS app version 2.3.2 says the app still crashes on launch. Is that the known 2.3.1 issue?
expected_answer: No. The 2.3.1 crash (MOB-982) was fixed in 2.3.2, so the known issue article doesn't apply. Collect the app version, the iOS version and the crash log, and escalate to Mobile Engineering.

question: On iPad Safari in landscape, the sidebar covers the board and the toolbar is cut off. When will it be fixed, and how should I close the case?
expected_answer: Open known issue FE-1290, fix planned for 2026.11.2. Recommend the native iPad app (or Request Desktop Website, collapsing the sidebar or portrait mode). Link the case to FE-1290 and set status to Pending Release, not Closed.

question: A Business customer bulk-edited a project by mistake 45 days ago. Can we restore it from backup?
expected_answer: No. Business backups are kept for 30 days, so 45 days ago is outside the backup window (Enterprise keeps 90 days). Field changes on individual tasks can still be reverted from the Activity tab.

question: Can a workspace Owner delete audit log entries, and how long does Enterprise keep them?
expected_answer: No. Entries can't be edited or deleted, including by Owners. Enterprise keeps them for 7 years (Business 1 year).

question: Can our Enterprise workspace use our root domain example.com as its custom domain?
expected_answer: No. Only subdomains (for example work.example.com) are supported, not apex domains. Create a CNAME to custom.lumora.example.

question: Is Lumora available in Italian?
expected_answer: Not yet. Italian and Polish are planned for the first half of 2027 (FR-077). Current languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese (BR), French, German, Japanese and Dutch. Don't promise a date.

question: How much does the Business plan cost per user per month?
expected_answer: Not in the knowledge base. The articles list plan limits but no prices. The answer should say so and suggest the pricing page or the account team, not invent a figure.

question: Does Lumora have a two-way sync with Microsoft Outlook calendars?
expected_answer: Not in the knowledge base. Only Google Calendar sync is documented (KA-0032). The answer should not assume that Outlook works the same way.

question: Can we choose to keep our workspace data in an EU data center?
expected_answer: Not in the knowledge base. Regions are mentioned only in passing (backups in a separate region, speed test to the nearest region). The answer should say data residency isn't covered.

question: Will Lumora sign a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement?
expected_answer: Not in the knowledge base. Only SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and the DPA are mentioned (KA-0043). The answer should not claim HIPAA support either way.

question: Does the Android app version 2.3.1 also crash on launch?
expected_answer: Not in the knowledge base. The 2.3.1 crash article covers iOS only (KA-0040). The answer should not extend it to Android.
